tasks.label: Device: bundle (clean)
tasks.command: cargo clean -p esp-idf-sys --target riscv32imafc-esp-espidf --release && cargo clean -p device/firmware --target riscv32imafc-esp-espidf --release && rm -rf target/devcontainer/riscv32imafc-esp-espidf/release/build/esp-idf-sys-*/out/build && cargo xtask bundle-device --release
tasks.detail: Clean rebuild: drops esp-idf-sys, firmware, and the CMake build dir before bundling. Use when sdkconfig or extra_components changes don't seem to land. Takes ~2-3 minutes.

tasks.label: Android: install toolchain
tasks.detail: Idempotent: installs Temurin JDK 21 + Android SDK (platform-35, build-tools 35) under /work/.tools and appends env to ~/.bashrc. Skip when already installed.

tasks.label: Android: assemble debug
tasks.detail: Builds + prints the resulting APK path. Output lives at companion-apps/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk (~70 s clean, ~10 s incremental).

tasks.label: Android: assemble release
tasks.detail: Builds the unsigned release APK and prints its path. File lands at companion-apps/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk; needs a real signing config before publishing.

tasks.label: Android: lint + compile
tasks.detail: Faster gate when iterating: compiles Kotlin and runs Android Lint without packaging an APK.

tasks.label: iOS: test (simulator)
tasks.detail: Triggers the self-hosted macOS runner to build the iOS companion app for simulator and run XCTests. Check progress with: gh run watch

tasks.label: i18n: sync all translations
tasks.detail: Calls OpenAI to fill missing translations for every non-source locale in i18n/catalog.config.json, then regenerates the per-platform JSON / xcstrings / strings.xml outputs. Reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the env or from .env at the workspace root (copy .env.example to start).

tasks.label: i18n: sync all translations (dry run)
tasks.detail: Shows which keys would be sent to OpenAI without making any API calls. Use this before the real run to estimate cost or verify the catalog diff.

tasks.label: iOS: build (simulator validation)
tasks.detail: Triggers the self-hosted macOS runner to build the iOS companion app for simulator and run unit tests. Check progress with: gh run watch

tasks.label: i18n: regenerate platform outputs
tasks.detail: Refreshes companion-apps/web JSON, iOS xcstrings + Resources/Messages JSON, Android strings.xml + raw JSON, and the cue parity fixture from i18n/locales/*.json. Run after editing any locale file by hand.
